description: Move or copy emails BETWEEN accounts, preserving the original message intact (sender, date, threading) by transferring the raw MIME. Fetches each message from the source account and imports it into the target account. With deleteAfter=true the source copy is sent to trash only after a confirmed import, making this a safe cross-account move.

deleteAfter.description: Send the source copy to trash after a successful import. Default false (copy, leaving the original in place).

markRead.description: Mark imported messages as read in the target. Default: provider default (usually unread).

sourceFolder.description: Source folder (required for IMAP/iCloud when emails are not in INBOX)

targetFolder.description: Destination folder/label in the target account (Gmail label id or name; IMAP/Outlook folder name). Defaults to INBOX.

name: email_transfer
